title: Cover malformed and bounded Codex permission profiles with refusal behavior tests
outcome: Cover malformed and bounded Codex permission profiles with refusal behavior tests
acceptance: Behavioral requests cover non-null environmentId, non-string grantRoot, pattern/special entries, oversized read/write/entries arrays, unknown keys, relative paths and invalid globScanMaxDepth.
Each supported negative case returns the exact native decline payload and one bounded System notice without pending approval cards; tests assert behavior rather than reason-string copies.
Existing valid inside-cap, native granular policy, full-access, read-only delegation and stale/Stop behavior remain covered.
